name: Konyap-website
description: Production website and Supabase-powered CMS developed for a construction company.

paragraphs: A production marketing site and headless CMS-style admin panel for a construction & villa-development company in Konya, Turkey.

This repository powers konyapmuhendislik.com, the live marketing website for Konyap Mühendislik, a residential and commercial construction company based in Konya, Turkey. It is a real client project, not a template or demo: the public site showcases the company's villa and residential projects, services, and contact channels in Turkish, while a custom-built, authenticated admin panel lets the client manage projects, services, leads, and company details without touching code. The stack pairs a React 19 single-page app with Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Row-Level Security) as the backend, and is…
features: Home / About / Services / Projects / Project Detail / Dreams / Contact pages, fully localized in Turkish
Project portfolio with status filtering (Tamamlandı / Devam Ediyor / Planlama), a featured/showcase project, image & YouTube video galleries, floor plans, amenities, and nearby points of interest
"Konyap Dreams" — a dedicated custom-project request flow for prospective clients (project type, budget range, location, description)
Lead capture forms (Contact + Dreams) that write directly to Supabase and simultaneously trigger email notifications via Formspree
Interactive map (Leaflet + OpenStreetMap) bounded to the Konya region, with a custom marker for the company office
